title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena

title: Specializing AI for Regulated Industries - How Domyn Uses NVIDIA Nemotron
summary: Domyn is specializing NVIDIA Nemotron-based models for regulated industries that need ownership, governance, transparency, and auditability rather than black-box deployment. Its pipeline combines model compression, multilingual continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning to build a 263B-parameter reasoning model plus smaller domain-specific models, targeting enterprise tasks such as text-to-SQL, knowledge graph extraction, and safety classification.

extra.full_text: Regulated industries require full ownership,control and customization of the models they deploy with end-to-end governance, transparency, and auditability. This livestream explores how Domyn has built and specialized its own models, including a 263B-parameter reasoning model purpose-built for regulated industries and smaller models for specific domains and tasks. We'll walk through the training pipeline: model compression, multilingual continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, leveraging the NVIDIA open source ecosystem. Learn how this approach delivers state-of-the-art results on enterprise tasks like text-to-SQL, knowledge graph extraction, and safety classification, and enable AI that you can own, control and customize, built for the demands of regulated industries.
